task: Harden the strict external AGI claim path after PR 146 so a weakened evaluator quorum cannot be presented through the production CLI as a valid strict claim configuration.
objective: Fail closed when the strict claim CLI is asked to use fewer than two independent evaluator groups per criterion and preserve the result as native O self-application state.

executor.role: O semantic execution, implementation, falsification, and validation stage

success_conditions: A CLI request for one independent evaluator group per criterion fails closed before reading evidence.
The default strict quorum remains two independent groups per criterion.
Existing valid strict-path behavior and full repository tests remain passing.
The change is merged only after exact-head CI success.
The resulting self-application record remains internal and inadmissible for an AGI claim.
actions: Reviewed the production external claim interface and found a caller-controlled lower quorum argument.
Implemented a strict lower bound at the CLI boundary and clarified help text.
Added a regression test using missing evidence files to prove the weakened quorum is rejected before any evidence read.
Verified exact head 8dc4cebfe31f3689230b7d3b5071c63762f47438 passed full CI run 32043824282 before merge.
decisions: Keep the production strict CLI fail-closed even though lower-level library calls may still be used explicitly for non-default development experiments.
Do not reinterpret the hardening as external evidence or capability proof.
Continue after this milestone to reduce external-evaluation friction and capability failure risk rather than stopping on merge.
observations: The prior CLI accepted --min-independent-groups-per-criterion=1 despite describing itself as the strict AGI claim gate.
The corrected CLI now blocks that weakening before touching the ledger or registry.
The independent production evidence ledger remains insufficient for an AGI claim.
claims: The user-facing strict claim CLI cannot lower the external evaluator quorum below two independent groups per criterion.
AGI remains unverified because no strict independent production evidence quorum has passed.
unknowns: Whether independent external evaluators will complete the strict protocol remains unknown.
Whether the lower-level library should eventually separate development-policy support from the AGI-positive field more explicitly remains a review item.
unresolved: Build a reproducible evaluator handoff that derives an exact source artifact digest from a frozen commit instead of relying on an opaque caller-supplied artifact hash.
Obtain genuinely independent signed production evidence across all six criteria and both required evaluator groups.
Continue capability and retention work that reduces the probability of external evaluation failure.
